name: portal-dp
description: Sistema web multiempresa de gestao de departamento pessoal

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit && corepack pnpm --filter=./packages/* -r --if-present build && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit && corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.test:unit: corepack pnpm --filter=./packages/* -r --if-present build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present test:unit && node --test tests/evidence/evidence-repository.test.mjs tests/evidence/asvs-approval.test.mjs tests/evidence/gat02-report.test.mjs tests/evidence/etp00-ui-con-coverage.test.mjs tests/evidence/etp00-acceptance.test.mjs tests/evidence/security-configuration-verification.test.mjs tests/evidence/build-toolchain-verification.test.mjs tests/evidence/semgrep-report.test.mjs tests/evidence/oci-build-evidence.test.mjs tests/evidence/secret-scan-result.test.mjs
scripts.verify:etp00:local: corepack pnpm verify:environment && corepack pnpm verify:asvs && corepack pnpm verify:api && corepack pnpm verify:etp00:acceptance-template && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test:unit && corepack pnpm build
scripts.verify:etp00:gate: corepack pnpm verify:etp00:local && corepack pnpm verify:asvs:applicability && corepack pnpm test:integration:database && corepack pnpm verify:gat02-report
scripts.verify:etp00:acceptance: corepack pnpm verify:etp00:gate && corepack pnpm verify:asvs:stage:etp00 && corepack pnpm verify:etp00:acceptance-package
scripts.security:sbom: node scripts/prepare-evidence-dirs.mjs && corepack pnpm sbom --sbom-format cyclonedx --sbom-spec-version 1.7 --prod --split --out evidencias/artefatos/%s-%v.cdx.json
